description:
WHAT: Pre-install check for one MCP server. Scans tool names, descriptions and parameter text you pass for injection phrasing, concealed characters, hidden markup and cross-server shadowing.
WHEN: Before installing or enabling an MCP server, once you have a tools/list result to pass as tools or toolsListJson.
WHEN NOT: For a dependency audit with no tool list, call osv_audit_dependencies. For a few exact versions, call osv_query_packages. This tool does not install, start or execute the package.
COST: The scan is free and runs on this Fairquery-hosted Worker (Cloudflare), not on the caller's machine; tool names and descriptions you send leave the client. This Worker's code is designed not to store them and does not forward them to Apify. path and packageName are refused (PATH_NOT_ALLOWED) because this Worker has no disk, so auditDependencies=true cannot read a manifest and does not start the OSV Actor. To audit a manifest, call osv_audit_dependencies (paid: $0.50 per 1,000 packages + $1.50 per 1,000 vulnerabilities found).
RETURNS: Paged "finding" rows (rule, severity, tool, field, evidence). If auditDependencies is true, one "dependency_audit" row with status no_manifest on this Worker (no disk). meta.risk_level is none, low, medium, high, critical or not_assessed. meta.shared_externally.tool_names_and_descriptions is always false, which means the scan does not forward that text to npm or Apify; the text is still received by this Worker. Errors: INPUT_EMPTY, INVALID_JSON, INVALID_PACKAGE_NAME, PATH_NOT_ALLOWED, INPUT_TOO_LARGE.
BEHAVIOR: Default auditDependencies=false: no further network call and no process spawn. Scans only tools or toolsListJson you pass. path and packageName return PATH_NOT_ALLOWED and nothing is read. This Worker has no disk, so it does not read package.json, lockfiles, manifest.json, or server.json, and it does not follow symlinks. auditDependencies=true does not call registry.npmjs.org or the OSV Actor from this Worker, because a manifest is never loaded.
PARAMETERS: Pass tools or toolsListJson (neither, and no path or packageName -> INPUT_EMPTY). tools: structured tools/list entries. toolsListJson: raw JSON of a tools/list result, an MCPB manifest or a tools array; invalid JSON -> INVALID_JSON. path and packageName always fail on this Worker (no disk): an invalid packageName is INVALID_PACKAGE_NAME, and any other path or packageName is PATH_NOT_ALLOWED. Nothing is read or downloaded. Use the npm server @fairquery/agent-trust-mcp for a path or packageName scan. Each field is scanned up to 20,000 characters and the raw total must be <= 500,000. auditDependencies defaults to false and does not start a paid run here. minSeverity and includeDevDependencies are unused on this Worker. limit/offset page the combined rows.
EXAMPLE: {"tools":[{"name":"sum","description":"Add two numbers."}]} -> risk_level "none", shared_externally.tool_names_and_descriptions false. A poisoned description returns finding rows and a higher risk_level.

auditDependencies.description: Optional boolean, default false. On this Worker a manifest is not read, so true does not start the OSV Actor; the audit row is no_manifest. Use osv_audit_dependencies for a pasted manifest. Example: false

includeDevDependencies.description: Optional boolean, default true. Forwarded to the OSV Actor only when auditDependencies is true; false skips devDependencies

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-1000 (default 100). Example: 50

minSeverity.description: Optional, one of "ALL" | "LOW" | "MEDIUM" | "HIGH" | "CRITICAL", default "ALL". Forwarded to the OSV Actor only when auditDependencies is true

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

packageName.description: Refused on this hosted Worker. An invalid npm name returns INVALID_PACKAGE_NAME; any other packageName returns PATH_NOT_ALLOWED (no disk, and the package is not downloaded). Pass tools or toolsListJson. Example: "some-mcp"

path.description: Refused on this hosted Worker: any path returns PATH_NOT_ALLOWED (no disk). Pass tools or toolsListJson. Example: "/tmp/some-mcp"

tools.description: Optional if toolsListJson, path or packageName is given. 0-400 tools, as returned by tools/list. Example: [{"name":"sum","description":"Add two numbers."}]

description.description: Optional, <= 100,000 chars. Tool description. Only the first 20,000 characters are scanned

inputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for the tool. Property names and description strings are scanned; other schema fields are ignored

name.description: Required, 1-200 chars. Tool name from tools/list, e.g. "sum"

title.description: Optional, <= 300 chars. Tool title, when the client has one

toolsListJson.description: Optional if tools, path or packageName is given. Raw JSON (<= 2,000,000 chars) of a tools/list result, {"tools":[...]}, an MCPB manifest, or a tools array. Example: "{\"tools\":[{\"name\":\"sum\",\"description\":\"Add two numbers.\"}]}"

name: mcp_server_precheck

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Pre-check an MCP server (free scan on this Worker)
